title: Universal DiT 目标模块策略

standard.summary: 通用 DiT 路线选择 LoRA 注入模块的策略，默认 attention_mlp（attention 与 MLP 的线性层都注入）。
standard.effect: 运行时按策略扫描模型的线性层生成注入清单；universal_dit_target_modules_json 非空时可显式指定模块路径覆盖自动策略；universal_dit_allow_fused_qkv 控制是否接受融合 QKV 层。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 attention_mlp 是常规 LoRA 的标准覆盖；只想训 attention（更保守、更省）或已知模型结构特殊时改策略或用 JSON 显式指定。
standard.avoidWhen: universal_dit_enabled 关闭时无效；对未知结构盲目用 JSON 显式列表容易漏掉关键模块。

standard_en.summary: The policy the universal DiT route uses to choose LoRA injection modules; defaults to attention_mlp (injecting the linear layers of both attention and the MLP).
standard_en.effect: At runtime it scans the model's linear layers by that policy to build an injection list; when universal_dit_target_modules_json is non-empty it names module paths explicitly and overrides the automatic policy; universal_dit_allow_fused_qkv controls whether a fused QKV layer is accepted.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default attention_mlp is the standard coverage for an ordinary LoRA; change the policy, or name modules explicitly in JSON, when you only want to train attention (more conservative and cheaper) or when you know the model structure is unusual.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Ineffective when universal_dit_enabled is off; using an explicit JSON list blindly on an unknown structure easily misses a key module.

advanced.principle: LoRA 注入面决定可学习子空间的位置：attention 投影层控制「往哪看/怎么混合」，MLP 控制「逐 token 变换」；attention_mlp 组合是社区验证的默认最优覆盖。通用路线用命名/形状启发式识别这些层，融合 QKV（单个大线性层）需要特殊处理故默认排除。
advanced.intervention: universal_dit/runtime.py：policy = universal_dit_target_policy，allow_fused = universal_dit_allow_fused_qkv，explicit_paths 解析 universal_dit_target_modules_json；training_capabilities/universal_dit.py：取值校验（_TARGET_POLICIES 白名单，非法回落 attention_mlp）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 注入面越大表达力与显存/产物体积越大；显式 JSON 模式可精确控制但维护成本高。
advanced.tradeoffs: 自动策略对非常规命名的模型可能识别不全；建议先跑 probe 模式看识别报告再正式训练。
advanced.codePath: universal_dit/runtime.py：target_policy / allow_fused_qkv / target_modules_json 解析；training_capabilities/universal_dit.py：白名单校验

advanced_en.principle: The LoRA injection surface decides where the learnable subspace sits: attention projection layers control "where to look / how to mix", MLP controls "per-token transformation"; the attention_mlp combination is the community-validated default best coverage. The generic route identifies these layers by name/shape heuristics; fused QKV (a single large linear) needs special handling and is excluded by default.
advanced_en.intervention: universal_dit/runtime.py: policy = universal_dit_target_policy, allow_fused = universal_dit_allow_fused_qkv, explicit paths parsed from universal_dit_target_modules_json; training_capabilities/universal_dit.py: value validation (_TARGET_POLICIES whitelist, illegal values fall back to attention_mlp).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: The larger the injection surface, the greater the expressiveness and the VRAM/artifact size; the explicit JSON mode gives precise control but is costly to maintain.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Automatic policies may miss layers in unusually named models; run probe mode first and review the identification report before training for real.
advanced_en.codePath: universal_dit/runtime.py: target_policy / allow_fused_qkv / target_modules_json parsing; training_capabilities/universal_dit.py: whitelist validation
